raw_text:
- Determine the factors contributing to persistent completion-time differences between sites with the same nominal work process.
- Identify measurable factors that account for differences.

Assumptions
- Process changes within and between sites can affect completion times.

Research design

Data or evidence needed: 
- Completion time data for sites with the same nominal work process.
- Process-measurement data (e.g., hours per day, team size).

Measurement
- Primary: Completion time and process efficiency.
- Secondary: Work hours per day, team size, process wait times.

Analysis
- Compare completion times for similar work processes.
- Use process-measurement data to identify potential factors contributing to differences.

Decision / stopping rule
- If consistent patterns emerge in completion-time differences and potential contributing factors, conclude that multiple factors affect completion times.

Limitations
- Limited availability of external data.
- Im precision in completion-time recording.
